claim_one_line: THE EIGENVALUE-ONE LOCUS, run as sealed (44cdb4a6; sL-10 item 9): near the hyperbolic point of every word state to length 12 and of m004's levels M2-M6, no vacuum nu (x) Lambda^2 rho carries a non-zero class index for any deformation in Hom(Gamma, SL(4,C)) (types 2 and 3, real or complex) and any character nu (Theorem N: the simple-root condition SR, read at all 47,333 base points, makes the fibre's interior polynomial chi_K non-zero at every special twist, so Lemma F's index vanishes; Lemma O keeps e in {0, 2}); nu (x) rho carries none wherever the four's base condition holds (Lemma K, the sandwich), which is at 46,824 of the 46,826 word-state base points and on the levels at all but M6's 28. The base condition fails on one word state, m135 = -LLRR, at its two order-2 characters trivial on the cusp: one interior class each for V and V* (parabolic-preserving infinitesimal deformations into SO(4,1) on m135's double covers), read in three routes at 60 digits and exactly over Q(zeta_8). As sealed 5 of 7 predictions held: P2 (m135) and P4 (the location rate, 143 of 196 brackets; 44 of the others are sign changes through a pole of b on +-L3RLR2, an E31 instance) failed; P5 and P6 held at every located crossing. After the run 180 of the 200 first-order crossings are located, all twenty on nine rings, with I = 0 on 11,640 route-T and 1,640 Fox and W rows. Kill record the-interior-polynomial-decides (F-HE, class). Registered: item 10 (the four's coincidence loci at m135's two base points and M6's 28). I-26 stays UNEARNED. 0 of 19.
